messages:
jo: FYI starting a focused scrub this week: ownerless admin bindings + unlabeled KMS keys across prod/staging. Posting quick guardrail & ask.

rita: ack. what's the timeline? we should avoid surprise outages.

jo: timeline: 48h self-attest, 10d quarantine (console/API disabled), 45d retention snapshot then archival actions. emergency exceptions via security-oncall.

sam: sounds good. can we gate owner changes via infra repo? add a pre-merge check that disallows `roles/owner` without CODEOWNERS approval.

jo: yes, plan: infra PR to add `owner-change-check` CI and an owners map. I'll draft PR.

sam: paste short scans commands so oncall can run nightly: 
```
# GCP owners
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $P --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role|test("owner|roles/owner"))'
# GCP KMS keys
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --format="value(name,labels)"
# AWS KMS
aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' --output text | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms describe-key --key-id {}
```

rita: uploaded scan -> gs://redwood-security/scrub/3101234567-scan.csv (9 rows). sample: svcacct-ml-infer@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com,owner=null; key-payment-prod,labels=null

cloud-bot: attestation:run_started ts=3101234567 scope=org module=ownerless_scan

jo: assigned owners in sheet: svcacct-ml-infer -> @rita, key-payment-prod -> @sam. If no owner in 48h we'll apply `quarantine:pending` label and disable console keys.

retention-bot: retention-mandate: archive_required=true retention_days=365 note="Retention will request snapshot before destructive ops"

rita: i'll add remediation steps to the runbook: disable console/API, rotate keys for any live consumers, mark terraform to reflect owner map, and document proof-of-rotation artifact.

sam: i'll open infra PR for CI gating and add example terraform snippet to populate owner map.

cloud-bot: attestation:run_complete ts=3101234999 status=partial_orphans=9 report=gs://redwood-security/scrub/3101234567-report.json

jo: thanks all. follow-ups: (1) @sam PR for gating (2) @rita remediation playbooks + rotation proof (3) i'll send attestation email and start 48h timer. reconvene if >5 orphans after quarantine. :calendar:
